snippet.title: Lord of Ogre Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now on Steam 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3464490/Lord_of_Ogre/ 


This is the second showcase of Lord of Ogre, a Tactical RPG featuring a unique blend of battle mechanics such as combo attacks and parry defense.

We’ve expanded on the systems introduced in the Reveal Trailer by adding a more advanced combo system, where players can also discover special moves through specific combo inputs.

Additionally, we’ve implemented an Auto-Battle mode, in which combos are executed automatically—but with randomized efficiency, making every battle unpredictable.

Music Composer : Yoshiki Ara
Fantasy RPG Music /Asgard Aube Season 1 Ancient Dragon

- Website  https://www.lordofogre.com/
